lineKo: 오늘 {nth} 실려 왔어. 괜찮아? 뭐가 꼬였는지 같이 볼래?
lineEn: They brought you in {nth} today. You okay? Want to look at what went wrong together?

lineKo: 내가 더 분명히 말했어야 했는데. 지금이라도 같이 정비하고 갈까?
lineEn: I should have said it more clearly. Want to get things sorted together before you go again?

lineKo: 함선 상태가 좀 마음에 걸려. 나가기 전에 한 번만 봐 줄래?
lineEn: Your ship's condition is bugging me a little. Take a look before you head out?

lineKo: 왔구나. {d} 만이네. 나는 그동안 당직만 서고 있었어.
lineEn: There you are. It's been {d}. I've just been standing watch.
Saw the new ship. Do you like it?

lineKo: 편입 소식 들었어. 우리 쪽이 하나 늘었네.
lineEn: Heard about the annexation. One more on our side.

lineKo: 공사 시작했다며. 다 지으면 나도 보러 갈래.
lineEn: Heard you started construction. I want to see it when it's done.

lineKo: 아까 그거, 잘 풀렸네. 나도 기분 좋다.
lineEn: That thing earlier worked out. Makes me happy too.

lineKo: 한 단계 또 올라섰다며. 축하해, 진짜로.
lineEn: Heard you moved up again. Congrats, really.

lineKo: 요즘 한 군데서 좀 막힌 것 같아. 얘기해 볼래?
lineEn: Seems like you're a bit stuck on something. Want to talk it through?

lineKo: 거기서 계속 싸우는 이유가 있어? 궁금해서.
lineEn: Any reason you keep fighting there? Just curious.

lineKo: 오래 했다. 잠깐 쉬었다 해도 괜찮아.
lineEn: You've been at it a while. It's okay to take a break.
Lots of trading today. Having fun?
